5fb29e38dda1f.title: Navigator Multi-Layer Controller provide
5fb29e38dda1f.textContent: Navigator Multi-Layer Controller provides comprehensive multi-layer network visibility and software control across Ciena and third-party infrastructure, so teams can efficiently coordinate lifecycle network operations, eliminating manual handoffs between multiple systems.

5fb2a009dda24.title: Navigator Intelligent Apps deliver proac
5fb2a009dda24.textContent: Navigator Intelligent Apps deliver proactive insights based on a wealth of real-time and historical data to drive better decisions and simplify troubleshooting, increase network resiliency, and optimize network performance.

5fb2a2acdda2c.title: Liquid Spectrum apps improve visibility
5fb2a2acdda2c.textContent: Liquid Spectrum apps improve visibility of the photonic layer, enabling you to increase network capacity and service availability from optical infrastructure investment, driving down cost and power per bit.

5fb2a414dda2f.title: Adaptive IP Apps speed up resolution of
5fb2a414dda2f.textContent: Adaptive IP Apps speed up resolution of customer service issues through advanced visualization, real-time analysis and constraint-based path computation for IP, multi-protocol label switching, and segment routing networks.
